title: Old Sable Canopy Road
kicker: The living road beneath the branded logistics layer, remembered by locals as a place instead of a service corridor.
hook: The living road beneath the branded logistics layer, remembered by locals as a place instead of a service corridor.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The canopy road feels like travel through the forest's memory: dim green light, root-shadow bends, and old markers half-swallowed by moss.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: The road here leaves the ground entirely. Plank landings wrap the great trunks, rope bridges sway between branches, and crates ride overhead on squealing pulleys. Wildlife has moved into the structure, so half the handholds are also somebody's nest. The...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Trail food gets hauled up in baskets packed tight to survive the swing, dried fruit, hard cheese, flatbread gone slightly stale. You eat it sitting on a platform with your boots hanging out over a long green drop.
